mapper.insert: insert into addrbook(ab_name, ab_email, ab_comdept, ab_birth, ab_tel, ab_memo) values (#{abName},#{abEmail}, #{abComdept}, #{abBirth}, #{abTel}, #{abMemo})
mapper.select: select ab_id , ab_name , ab_email , ab_comdept , ab_birth , ab_memo , ab_tel from addrbook
select ab_id , ab_name , ab_email , ab_comdept , ab_birth , ab_memo , ab_tel from addrbook where ab_id = #{abId}
